Name: Better Marlon for Seasonal Outfits and SVE
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
[size=3]THIS IS NOT A MOD, THESE ARE JUST IMAGE FILES. You will need the mod. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]


And then replace the images! Now also updated for SVE!![/size]

After upgrading the Wizard, I thought about who my next victim would be and realized Marlon had a lot of potential :)

In the portraits, I changed his hair, beard (there's a normal option and a full beard option), eyepatch, some clothes (basically just the color and another outfit for the flower festival), and some details on his face (now he has scars and an ear).

In the sprite, I slightly modified the hair and beard and the colors of some clothes.

(I wanted to add a sword, but I was having trouble making it, so I left it out :p).
[code]﻿[/code]

[size=5]Installation:
[/size]
[list]
[*]Download the mod manually and extract it.
[*]Open the "marlon" folder.
[*]You will find three folders: "character", "portrait", and "portrait with full beard" (you will choose the type of beard you want).
[*]Copy the images and paste them into the "marlon" folder of the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod, overwriting all changes (place the portrait images in the "marlon" folder inside the "portraits" folder of the mod, and the character images in the "marlon" folder inside the "characters" folder of the mod).
[*]Run the game normally.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy it! Feel free to comment if you have any feedback or if something isn't working. Thank you!
